card.name: Vol. in citations and partial drug names
card.fires_on: The word "Vol" (or its period) in journal and encyclopedia citations just before a volume number. Also the ending piece inside long enzyme and drug names such as gamma-glutamyl and prostin-il.

modes.label: Volume in citations
modes.description: "Vol" or the period after it, right before a volume or issue number in a reference.

modes.label: Inside enzyme or drug names
modes.description: The "yl" or "il" ending partway through a long chemical or drug name.

card.plain: It lights up on "Vol." in reference lists and on the middle of long names like gamma-glutamyl transferase.
